meta.title: Command Palette
meta.description: A fully-engineered ⌘K command menu with fuzzy search, two-tier tab filtering, keyboard navigation, grouped results, avatar support, and a keyboard shortcut footer.

blocks.content: Press ⌘K to open the palette. Type to search, use ↑↓ to navigate, Enter to select.
The command palette has no additional npm dependencies beyond what shadcn already installs. Fuzzy search is implemented from scratch — no external library required.
Wrap your app with CommandPaletteRoot and pass your sections. The ⌘K shortcut is wired automatically.
Items are grouped into sections. Each section has a title shown as a header above its items. Results are filtered and sorted by fuzzy score when the user types.

blocks.title: Avatar rendering
blocks.content: The icon field accepts a URL string (renders an ), a React node (renders as-is), or you can use initials + initialsColor for a coloured avatar fallback.
The palette supports two independent tab rows. Source tabs filter by integration (e.g. Gmail, Figma). Filter tabs filter by content type (People, Tasks, Files). Both are optional.
